title: Niagara-on-the-Lake Evening Beer & Wine Country Dinner Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Niagara's finest wineries and breweries on an evening tour that combines exquisite tastings and a delightful dinner. This European-inspired experience includes visits to three premier wineries and one brewery, showcasing a structured tasting seminar of premium wines and handcrafted beers. Finish the evening with a delicious three-course dinner at a top-rated restaurant in Niagara-on-the-Lake. Enjoy convenient pick-up and drop-off from your accommodation, making it easy to indulge in the flavors of the region without worry.

- Visit 3 wineries and 1 brewery, with 12-16 tastings included
- Fully guided tour with industry professionals to enhance your experience
- Roundtrip transportation in new model executive mini buses for up to 14 passengers
- Sample a gourmet three-course dinner with wine at a 4 Diamond restaurant
